prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers. Here he wears a simple black commuting backpack.

summary:
[reference generation] At night, <Subject 1> walks along a city sidewalk toward a brightly lit convenience store, turns to its glass door and pushes it open to step inside.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, lean build, gray T-shirt, unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt, black trousers and white sneakers are retained, with the black backpack added.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field and restrained contrast, with deep blue night tones and the cool-white glow of a shop front.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot of a quiet city sidewalk at night. On the right side of the frame stands the glass front of a clean, modern convenience store, its cool-white interior light spilling across the wet-looking pavement; shelves and drinks refrigerators glow softly out of focus inside, and the glass door is in the right third of the frame. <Subject 1>, his black backpack on both shoulders over the unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt, walks into the frame from the left at a calm after-work pace, seen in profile. His eyes look ahead along the sidewalk, then move to the glowing shop window as he approaches, and finally to the door handle. He turns toward the door, reaches out with his right hand, pushes the glass door open and steps through it into the light. Behind him, a woman with a tote bag walks past in the other direction at her own pace, and a delivery scooter passes slowly far away on the street; they stay softly out of focus with clear, stable silhouettes. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed, following him toward the door. His lips stay closed; he never looks into the lens. All shop signs and packaging stay blurred, and there is no readable text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Distant city traffic and a light breeze, his footsteps on the pavement, and a soft electronic entrance chime exactly when the door opens, followed by the hum of the store spilling out.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
